items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 「蒲公英骑士」，琴，申请入队。从今往后，我的荣誉与忠诚将与你同在！
items.text_en: I am Jean, the Dandelion Knight, requesting approval to join your party. From this day onwards, my honor and loyalty lie with you.

items.title: 闲聊·行动
items.text: 行动起来吧，我们不该在这里停留。
items.text_en: It's time to move on, we shouldn't stay here.

items.title: 闲聊·骑士团
items.text: 骑士团的大家…有没有认真工作呢？
items.text_en: I do hope the Knights of Favonius are all working hard...

items.title: 闲聊·目标
items.text: 走吧，前往下一个目标！
items.text_en: Onwards! We have work to do.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 下雨也无法阻挡我的脚步。
items.text_en: The rain won't slow me down.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 这样的天气，正适合行动。
items.text_en: This weather is perfect, we should move out.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 下雪了，要注意战靴的保养啊。
items.text_en: Huh, snow. Remember — tend to your boots when we return.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 舒适的天气。
items.text_en: Such fine weather.

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 传说，那天也刮着罕见的大风…
items.text_en: Legend has it the wind was unusually strong on that day, too...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 「一日之计在于晨」，今天也请加油。
items.text_en: A successful day starts from the morning. Let's give it our all today.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 好，现在开始处理任务吧。
items.text_en: We've still got work to do. Let's keep going.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 看样子，差不多已经对咖啡免疫了。如果有什么替代品的话…问问丽莎好了。
items.text_en: Huh, it seems I'm immune to coffee now. Perhaps I need to ask Lisa for something... a little stronger...

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 今日的修炼就到此为止，做得很棒，辛苦你了。
items.text_en: Training is finished for today. Great work, you've earned a good rest.

items.title: 关于琴自己
items.text: 今天为了保护民众，把五座遗迹守卫斩成了碎片。唉，我还需要继续磨练自己…这么珍贵的文化遗产，下次应该尝试空手制服…
items.text_en: Today I had no choice but to cut down five Ruin Guards to protect the people of our city... Ugh, I must continue to work harder. Though hostile, destroying such precious artifacts is still a loss to us all. I must find a less destructive way to bring them down next time...

items.title: 关于我们·信条
items.text: 我会全力帮助你，当然，如果你的方向偏离了正义，我也会毫不犹豫地指出。
items.text_en: You have my complete and full support. Of course, if your path ever deviates from justice, I will not hesitate to point it out.

items.title: 关于我们·誓言
items.text: 我以此剑起誓，必将胜利献给你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I swear by this sword, victory shall be yours.

items.title: 关于我们·任务
items.text: 任务可是不会自动完成的，但适当放松一下也好。今天就破例午休几分钟吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Our work will not handle itself... But, I suppose the occasional short break is warranted. Let us rest for a couple of minutes.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「永护蒙德」是古恩希尔德家族的家训。每当驱动「神之眼」，我都会想起母亲、还有蒙德民众的期盼。为蒙德而战，为自由而战——我，在所不辞。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4For Mondstadt, as always is the Gunnhildr family motto. Every time I use my Vision, I am reminded of my mother and the hopes of the people of Mondstadt. For Mondstadt, for freedom — that is what I fight for.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 我谨代表西风骑士团，向你为蒙德所做的一切致以谢意。还请你劳逸结合，量力而…怎么了，你突然笑了起来，我说了什么奇怪的话吗？
items.text_en: On behalf of the Knights of Favonius, I would like to extend my gratitude to you for all you have done for Mondstadt. Please remember to rest from time to ti... Did I miss something? What are you laughing at? Did I say something odd?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 「蒲公英，蒲公英，跟风一起，到远方去吧。」…它乘上风，说不定连天空岛都能飞到呢。
items.text_en: "Dandelion, Dandelion, ride the wind to a faraway land." Who knows, the wind might take it all the way to Celestia.

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 芭芭拉非常努力，只不过有时过于勉强自己…嗯？问我为什么了解得这么清楚？因为西风教会也归属骑士团管辖。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Barbara is a hard worker, but I feel she's too hard on herself sometimes... What? You ask me how I know all of this? It's because the order also manages the Church.

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎，有她在的话，我会安心很多。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4When Lisa is around, I always have peace of mind.

items.title: 关于安柏
items.text: 安柏这段时间确实有所成长。希望有朝一日，她的事迹也会被吟游诗人传颂。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I must say that Amber's development has impressed me recently. I hope that one day, her deeds will become the words of a bard's tale.

items.title: 关于凯亚
items.text: 是吗…凯亚也向你提出建言了啊。他是一名优秀的西风骑士，这点毋庸置疑。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Is that right...? Kaeya also gave you some suggestions. He is an excellent knight after all — this is a fact no one can deny.

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 虽说玩乐是孩子的天性，但可莉中意的玩具却都是些危险品。让人难以放心。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Though it may be said that it is in a child's nature to play, the things Klee plays with are far from toys. I can never take my eye off her.

items.title: 关于阿贝多
items.text: 「天才」这种名词，或许正是为了阿贝多这样的人准备的吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sometimes I feel that terms like "genius" were originally created for Albedo.

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 法尔伽大团长，他是西风骑士团的当代传奇。等到他凯旋归来的那一天，就请你亲自和他交谈吧。相信你也能从中受益。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Grand Master Varka is the legend of his generation. On the day of his triumphant return, I shall be sure to personally introduce you to him. I'm sure you too will be in awe of his greatness.

items.title: 关于诺艾尔
items.text: 诺艾尔，嗯…那个努力想要成为西风骑士的少女。她的内心仍有软弱之处，现在这个阶段，也许还不适合让她接触外界的凶险。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Noelle... She's very trying in her pursuit to become a Knight of Favonius. However, I fear she is not quite ready for the dangers that lie beyond Mondstadt's walls.

items.title: 关于罗莎莉亚
items.text: 罗莎莉亚修女总是把「麻烦」挂在嘴边，实际却十分称职。上次我和她说「如果觉得麻烦也可以找我帮忙」，她却回答「这样更麻烦」。嗯…我果然还有很多欠缺啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Some may see Sister Rosaria as one who complains about how bothersome her work is, but she does her job well. Last time I saw her I told her she could come find me should she ever need help, to which she simply replied that doing so would be even more bothersome. I need to work harder to become of more assistance to the people of Mondstadt.

items.title: 关于迪卢克·愧欠
items.text: 迪卢克前辈对骑士团的指摘事出有因，即使心中愧疚也无法改变既定的结果…我只想通过我的努力，让他对骑士团有所改观…嗯，这是我的责任。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Master Diluc has his reasons for being so critical of the Knights of Favonius. I am not proud of the way things went, but I cannot change the past. All I can do is keep working hard, in the hope he may one day see us in a better light... This is my duty.

items.title: 关于迪卢克·敬重
items.text: 迪卢克…是一位非常可敬的前辈。虽然我们选择的道路不同，但这份共通的守护蒙德的心意，我能感受得到。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Master Diluc is my senior, and I have the utmost respect for him. Though we have gone separate ways, I can sense we share the same strong commitment to protecting Mondstadt at all costs.

items.title: 关于砂糖
items.text: 作为炼金术士，砂糖也算天赋异禀。况且她的身边还有阿贝多指点，未来应该不用担心。只是…不，没什么，沉浸在自己的世界里，也不算坏事吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sucrose is also a rare talent in the field of alchemy. Under Albedo's mentorship, she is sure to flourish. I am sure her future will be bright. The only thing is... Ahem, I was momentarily lost in thought. It is nothing. Nothing bad, anyway.

items.title: 关于优菈
items.text: 优菈？咳…请不要对她的身世耿耿于怀，西风骑士会公正地评价每个人。优菈明辨是非，才华出众，偶尔发表危险言论，也只是她的性格使然。哪怕她总是说要挑战我，我也不介意。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Eula? Um... Please, do not hold her unfortunate background against her. The Knights of Favonius evaluate each person impartially. Eula has a clear sense of right and wrong and is more talented than most. The controversial statements that she makes from time to time are just a product of her personality. For instance, she always mentions wanting to challenge me, but I do not mind.

items.title: 关于米卡
items.text: 大团长选中米卡作为远征队的前侦骨干，不仅是出于任务需要，更是看中了他踏实勤恳的品质。从我个人角度而言，我也很荣幸能与这样的同伴共事。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Grand Master placed Mika on the front line of the expedition team not simply because he met the requirements of the mission — more importantly, he was impressed by Mika's hardworking and grounded nature. From my own perspective, I feel very honored to work with someone like him.

items.title: 想要了解琴·其一
items.text: 我肩负着西风骑士团的信任，还有蒙德民众的期待。为此，我不能松懈。
items.text_en: I shoulder the knights' trust and the people's hope. It is for this reason, I must stay vigilant.

items.title: 想要了解琴·其二
items.text: 温妮莎的「蒲公英骑士」之名传承至今，曾经有无数伟大的骑士获授这一荣誉。我不能辱没这个名字。因此，决不能松懈。要成为守护众人的坚盾与利剑。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Vennessa's title — "Dandelion Knight" — has been passed down from generation to generation. Countless great knights were awarded with this honor and I will not bring shame to this name. Thus, I must keep going. I must become the sword and aegis of the people.

items.title: 想要了解琴·其三
items.text: 无论是传奇故事还是史书，都只记载了伟大骑士的功绩。难道，他们一次也不曾迷失过吗…？风啊，请指引我前进的道路。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Only glorious victories are recorded in legends and history books. Surely even the great knights of old must have had their struggles? Wind, please show me the path.

items.title: 想要了解琴·其四
items.text: 全身心投入工作的时候，烦恼和时间会一并被忘却。「你是最适合做这种事情的人选。」…那个时候，大团长法尔伽就是这样对我说的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5When I'm wholeheartedly devoted to my work, all of my troubles and even my sense of time seem to just slip away. Hmm, Grand Master Varka did say to me: "Jean, there is no better candidate for this task"...

items.title: 想要了解琴·其五
items.text: 与你同行时，前进的道路变得无比清晰。就好像，终于有人能依靠，这究竟是…不，一定是我还不够努力。绝对不能松懈，不能辜负西风骑士团和蒙德…但是，谢谢你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6As I walk with you, the path ahead becomes clearer. It's almost as if I have finally found someone I can trust. I wonder if... No, this must mean that I am still lacking in strength... I must not give up, I will not — I cannot fail the Knights and the people of Mondstadt. Still... thank you.

items.title: 琴的爱好
items.text: 或许可以和你聊聊书上那些英雄传记。嗯，你听说过「坎瑞亚英雄王」的故事吗？
items.text_en: Maybe we can discuss the tales of legendary heroes. Have you heard the story of the heroic king of Khaenri'ah?

items.title: 琴的烦恼
items.text: 假如有什么神奇的药剂，喝了就不需要睡觉…嗯，要不明天问问丽莎吧？
items.text_en: If only there was some kind of mysterious potion that could let me stay awake forever... I need to have a talk with Lisa tomorrow.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 猫尾酒馆的披萨…很久没吃过了。如果能外送到办公室就好了呢。
items.text_en: It's been ages since I had pizza at Cat's Tail. If only they delivered...

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 优秀的骑士不能挑食。
items.text_en: A true knight can't afford to be a picky eater.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 不仅味道好，还兼顾了健康。让你费心了。
items.text_en: Not only is the taste magnificent, but you've also made sure it was healthy. You have my gratitude.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 嗯，精神振奋不少。谢谢你。
items.text_en: Hmm yes, I feel a lot more energetic now, thanks to you.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 呼…总之，辛苦你了。
items.text_en: Ahem... all in all, I appreciate the effort.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 今天是值得庆祝的日子。要说为何的话，因为这是受风护佑的你，诞生的日子啊。既然是生日，那就好好休息一下吧。咳咳…祝你生日快乐…啊，请原谅我的冒昧。不知这份礼物，是否能令你满意呢？
items.text_en: Today is a day worth celebrating. If you must ask why, well, let me remind you that today is when you, the one who is blessed by the wind, came into the world. Since this is your birthday, I'll allow you to take it easy. Ahem... ♪Happy birthday to you...♪ Uh... Please forgive my presumptuousness. I hope this gift is to your liking.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 好，一鼓作气前往下一个目标。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Good. On to our next objective.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 只要风不停歇，我就不会停下脚步。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2As the wind continues to blow, so too shall I continue to fight.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 就算暂时获得了平静，也不能掉以轻心。身为代理团长，我必须未雨绸缪。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Although we have peace, we must not become complacent. As the Acting Grand Master, I must remain vigilant.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我做得还不够好。自从与你相遇，一直承蒙你的关照。这份感激…风啊，请容许我的私心。并非作为代理团长，只是作为「琴」，在此起誓——我的剑将与你同在。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I am still not good enough. Ever since I met you, I have been indebted to you for your assistance. My gratitude... Wind, please forgive my selfishness. Not as the Acting Grand Master, but as Jean — I hereby swear that my sword shall always go with you.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 一决胜负！
items.text_en: Go as one!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text_en: Hah!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text_en: Huh!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 风，回应我吧。
items.text_en: Wind, hear me!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 以剑为誓！
items.text_en: I swear by my sword!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 风之神，请指引我们。
items.text_en: Barbatos, guide us.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 惊喜的收获。
items.text_en: What a pleasant surprise.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 嗯，真是幸运的一天。
items.text_en: Hmm, things are going a little too smoothly today...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 希望大家都能获得宝藏。
items.text_en: I hope the others find some.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 我，没事…！
items.text_en: I'm... I'm fine...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 还有同伴…需要保护…
items.text_en: My companions... need me...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 还不能放弃…
items.text_en: I can not give up...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 你受伤了…请暂时退后吧！
items.text_en: You're injured... get to safety!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 让我来吧。
items.text_en: I'll take over.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 蒙德…
items.text_en: Mondstadt...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 个人的力量是有极限的…
items.text_en: Everyone has their limits...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 我…还不够称职…
items.text_en: I have failed...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 这点伤而已！
items.text_en: Ugh! Barely a scratch!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 随时可以出发。
items.text_en: We may leave at any time.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 已做好万全准备。
items.text_en: Ready for anything.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 听凭风引。
items.text_en: Let the wind lead.
